title: Square recording and desktop evidence viewer
details: Video observations now request a true 1:1 720 × 720 camera stream so the live Milos preview matches the evidence frame being recorded
Square evidence recordings use approximately 1.1 Mbps video plus the existing 96 kbps audio to reduce file size without adding export-time transcoding
The evidence viewer now uses a desktop mode that keeps the complete video visible on the left while AC and timestamp controls remain in a fixed independently scrolling panel on the right
Portrait legacy recordings still use object-fit contain in the desktop viewer so the full frame remains visible instead of being cropped
Existing AC timestamp seeking, MP4 fast-start repair, WebM duration repair and complete evidence ZIP behaviour remain in place
